purpose: Test two explicitly extended finite-pattern candidates under independent gain/source allocation changes. Retain actual input/output spectra and distinguish nominal-coordinate transport from evidence about an unknown physical-power function.

legacy_hypothesis_definitions.dcp_continuous: Natural cubic spline evaluated on measured ordinary DCP output dBm, added to measured ordinary source phase.
legacy_hypothesis_definitions.raw_continuous: Same spline evaluated on ordinary raw spectral output power converted to dBm; measured ordinary source phase added.
legacy_hypothesis_definitions.raw_nominal_zero_bypass: Same raw-power spline; set only its increment to zero at the registered nominal zero-dBm control, without assuming raw power is exactly 0.001 W.
legacy_hypothesis_definitions.raw_report_zero_bypass: Same raw-power spline; set its increment to zero wherever ordinary DCP output power equals exactly 0.001 W.

historical_hypothesis_status: All four legacy candidates failed the previous complete ten-new-target study. No new local result rescinds those failures.

hypothesis_definitions.output_discrete_pattern: At this fixed table, use zero increment exactly when Decimal nominal output q is 0 or -0.000001 dBm; at every other registered configuration use the natural cubic spline on measured raw output power.
hypothesis_definitions.input_discrete_pattern: At this fixed table, use zero increment exactly when Decimal nominal source q-G is -20 or -20.000001 dBm; at every other registered configuration use the same natural cubic spline on measured raw output power.

local_spline_polynomial.source: Analytic natural-cubic interpolation of the frozen table, not fitted to new observations.

primary_evaluation.zero_increment_test: Circular difference between measured ordinary output and input phase no greater than 1e-5 degrees.
primary_evaluation.added_assumption: The two eight-point candidates explicitly add raw-spline behavior at all configurations outside their discrete nominal zero sets; that extension was not established by the old data.

allocation_comparisons.interpretation: Retain exact parsed binary64 equality separately from residuals. Approximate raw-power equality does not refute an arbitrary unknown output-only function or identify a threshold; these comparisons are descriptive.

input_power_identity.within_gain: DCP input divided by its registered same-gain zero control must match 10^(q/10), relative tolerance 1e-10.
input_power_identity.cross_gain: DCP input divided by the first G20 zero must match 10^((q-G+20)/10), relative tolerance 1e-7; this allows small loading differences and does not establish exact physical-input equality.
input_power_identity.source_parameter: Exact Decimal source expression q-G and exact gain expression, plus their SI readbacks, must match before and after each analysis.
input_power_identity.raw_input: Preserve input desired-carrier F1/P1/V1/Z1/ID1 nodes and validate physical V/Z/P, carrier support and phase. Raw input ratios, raw gain and raw-versus-DCP differences are descriptive, not cross-gain equality gates.

quick_sweeps.repeated_sweep_gate: Compare only with the first sweep at the same gain. Same-gain input relative tolerance is 1e-10, output 1e-7 and phase 1e-5 degrees. Never require cross-gain output equality.
quick_sweeps.interpretation: First G18/G22 scans are new auxiliary references, not historical reproductions. All 732 scan observations and up to twelve extra endpoints are excluded from ordinary prediction denominators.

acquisition_rules: Commit the plan, new normalizer, preparer, scorer and full exact helper/source workflow before any new analysis.
Use only the identified already-running SystemVue process; require zero open workspaces before opening each independently prepared input; save and close each result.
Validate 18 parameter readbacks, exact G and source Pwr expressions, explicit completion, empty diagnostics, ordinary input/output raw V/Z/P, timestamps and full sweep before another analysis.
Only the first and last G20-zero profiles use the complete 63-item historical baseline gate. Other historical ordinary comparisons are descriptive.

Stop on invalid acquisition, registered input identity failure, historical zero baseline failure or a same-gain repeated sweep failure; preserve every attempted call and restore without another analysis.
Candidate, fingerprint, cross-gain comparison and historical epsilon failures are results, not retry triggers. Complete the fixed sequence when technical and baseline/repeat gates pass.
Twelve calls maximum, no reserved or replacement calls; failed calls consume their slot. No fitting, tolerance changes, added targets or omission of valid observations.
Restore the original workspace and verify all 245 paths, 247 ordered parameter occurrences and metadata without extra analysis. Preserve unidentified or incomplete application state.
exclusions: These are two new finite-pattern extensions restricted to this table, not established vendor formulas or continuous/symmetric bypass windows.
All eight new configurations are prediction checks; only six yield divergent predicted zero/nonzero states. Partial fingerprints have applicable denominators six and two, not eight each.
Nominal source, raw input and reported input are distinct. This design cannot isolate parameter-expression mechanisms from physical-input mechanisms, nor exclude arbitrary gain-dependent branches.
Earlier G7 and G-3 zero-output results used different tables; they constrain global input-only claims but are not same-configuration controls here.
Equal nominal output or near-equal raw power cannot establish exact physical-output equality or uniquely identify the internal coordinate.
Fixed sequential blocks do not separate gain from time, order or hidden process state. Independent input files do not clear process caches.
Both candidates may fail or pass; finite successes do not choose a causal mechanism, authorize a product derivative contract or establish full DataPoints compatibility.
Partial acquisition must list missing profiles and uncompleted controls, without representing an observed prefix as the full study.
No product formula, tolerance or compatibility acceptance is changed by this registration.
